summary: Session 55 RETEST (frontend only). Re-grepped source (FAQ present at lines 214-282 of /app/frontend/src/pages/FondsGrundlagen.js) and re-ran browser tests with a cache-busting ?_ts= param after visitor-gate bypass via localStorage. iteration_22's 'FAQ not on disk / not in DOM' finding was a FALSE NEGATIVE (stale webpack chunk). All 12 Session 55 acceptance criteria now PASS: fonds-faq-list present, exactly 6 items (fonds-faq-item-0..5), each with an H3 question and non-empty <dd> answer (264-321 chars), H2 'Fonds in Kürze — FAQ' with eyebrow 'Häufige Fragen', anchor id='fonds-faq' present, DOM order correct (Anwendungsbeispiel idx 384 < FAQ 1386 < CTA 1434 < related 1441), RelatedKnowledge fonds-grundlagen-related shows 3 items -> /handeln, /themen/aktien, /themen/anleihen. Mobile 390x844: 6 items stacked, scrollWidth==clientWidth==390 (no horizontal overflow). Regression all green: /wissen 4 wissen-card-*, /handeln handeln-related 3 links, /themen overview renders, /themen/aktien 2 (/handeln, /themen/dividenden), /themen/anleihen 2 (/handeln, /fonds-grundlagen), /themen/dividenden 2 + hero image naturalWidth 1400, news article etf-zufluesse-europa-neues-jahreshoch still renders fonds-grundlagen-crosslink. No React errors, no key-collision warnings, no 404s.

The FAQ data array is inlined inside JSX; extracting it to /app/frontend/src/data/ would keep the 320-line page component cleaner and reusable.
Console shows a recurring 401 for an auth/session endpoint on anonymous public pages (pre-existing, harmless but noisy) — consider skipping the session probe when no auth cookie exists.

rca_of_the_issue: iteration_22 false negative root cause: the /fonds-grundlagen route is lazily code-split; the test ran while webpack was still recompiling that chunk, so the browser served the pre-change chunk and the FAQ nodes were absent from the DOM even though the source contained them. Mitigation used here: frontend restart + navigation with a ?_ts={timestamp} cache-buster and wait_until='networkidle' plus a 2s settle before DOM assertions.
